title.en: Kinematic viscosity of a motor oil: two-sided tolerance (JCGM 106 7.4)
title.tr: Motor yağının kinematik viskozitesi: iki taraflı tolerans (JCGM 106 7.4)

description.en: JCGM 106:2012 7.4 Example: SAE grade 40 oil at 100 °C, 12.5 mm²/s ≤ Y ≤ 16.3 mm²/s, measured 13.6 mm²/s with u = 1.8 mm²/s.
description.tr: JCGM 106:2012 7.4 Örnek: 100 °C'de SAE 40 yağ, 12,5 mm²/s ≤ Y ≤ 16,3 mm²/s, ölçülen 13,6 mm²/s, u = 1,8 mm²/s.

explanation.en: The measured value lies in the tolerance interval and the sample is accepted under simple acceptance, but the probability of conformity is only 66 %: the uncertainty is large compared with the tolerance (C_m = 3.8/(4 × 1.8) = 0.53).
explanation.tr: Ölçülen değer tolerans aralığındadır ve basit kabulle numune kabul edilir; ancak uygunluk olasılığı yalnızca %66'dır: belirsizlik toleransa göre büyüktür (C_m = 3,8/(4 × 1,8) = 0,53).

sources.document: JCGM 106:2012, Evaluation of measurement data — The role of measurement uncertainty in conformity assessment
